module: Statistics footer shared by the editor's "kit" tools: displays "Label N" stats in ImGui and the dynamic row of drawn triangles, distance and number of displayed pieces (computed by triLive). Uses the 'crystal' palette from style.lua.
notes: To be called inside an ImGui window; the functions draw directly with im.TextColored and im.SameLine.
As long as triLive has shapes to measure (toScan > 0), liveRow only displays "Drawn tris : scanning N shapes".

item.desc: Draws a "Label N" stat: dim label, colored number, dimmed "|" bar in front (except at the start of a line).

val.desc: Value displayed via tostring; 0 if nil/false.

lead.desc: True: start of line, no bar.

liveRow.desc: Displays drawn triangles ("Drawn tris"), range ("Range", in meters) and drawn pieces out of placed ones ("Drawing"). `unique` is added as is to the triangles because it has no LOD. Updates triLive (note if fresh, scanStep, update).

unique.desc: Triangles of the unique geometry, added in full.

fresh.desc: The list has changed since last time (may contain a shape never measured).
